meta.name: A Tale of the Secret Saint
meta.description: Fia always dreamed of being a great knight, despite her lack of talent as a swordswoman. Then, a brush with death in battle awakens memories of her past life as the legendary Saint who defeated the Demon King. Her powers return, but so do the enemies who killed her once before. Fia vows to conceal her true identity to survive. But how can a knight resist using her powers to help those in need?

videos.title: The Great Saint Awakens
videos.overview: While attempting to become a knight, Fia discovers a past she must hide at all costs.

videos.title: Fia and the Knight Brigade
videos.overview: The entrance exam will put Fia's cunning to the test and lead to significant encounters.

videos.title: The Saint's State of Being
videos.overview: Fia joins the Sixth Unit on a monster hunt.

videos.title: The Fourth Monster Tamer Knight Brigade
videos.overview: Fia is assigned to the Fourth Brigade to offer her talents.

videos.title: Calamitous Monsters
videos.overview: Fia meets Charlotte, a saint who needs a little boost to reach her potential.

videos.title: A Plan to Capture the Black King
videos.overview: Fia attends a meeting of captains. Meanwhile, Zavilia is hatching plans of his own.

videos.title: Zavilia
videos.overview: Fia and the knights fight several high-ranking monsters.

videos.title: My Adorable Friend
videos.overview: Zavilia leaves to become the king of dragonkind.

videos.title: Fia, to Sutherland
videos.overview: Fia travels to Sutherland to help. Cyril needs her help with something only she can do.
